name: Ipsapirone
summary: Ipsapirone is a selective 5-HT1A receptor partial agonist of the arylpiperazine and azapirone families which was under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder and anxiety disorders but was never marketed. It is taken orally.

pharmacology.text: Ipsapirone (INN, USAN, BAN; developmental code names BAY Q 7821 and TVX Q 7821) is a selective 5-HT1A receptor partial agonist of the arylpiperazine and azapirone families which was under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder and anxiety disorders but was never marketed. Ipsapirone produces 1-(2-pyrimidinyl)piperazine (1-PP), a potent α2-adrenergic receptor antagonist, as an active metabolite.

uses.text: Ipsapirone (INN, USAN, BAN; developmental code names BAY Q 7821 and TVX Q 7821) is a selective 5-HT1A receptor partial agonist of the arylpiperazine and azapirone families which was under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder and anxiety disorders but was never marketed. It was developed by Bayer. It was also studied for treatment of generalized anxiety disorder.
